issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the total-students accessor: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) refers to the method as get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case), whereas the template TODO, UML, and the solution implementation use the Java-style camelCase method name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch can confuse students about which exact method to implement and will cause their implementation or tests to fail if they follow the snake_case name (Java methods and the provided code/tests expect the camelCase name).
issues.suggestedFix: Edit problem_statement.md to use the camelCase Java method name getTotalNumberOfStudents() so the textual description matches the UML, template TODOs, and solution code. This preserves Java naming conventions and avoids mismatches between instructions and the expected implementation/tests.
